module: On-screen message display for crawl mode. Each showXxxMessage function sends a translated notification (ui.crawl.* keys) via ui_message, or via guihooks.trigger('Message') targeted at a player's panel in split screen (multiseat). It handles penalty, waypoint, finish, disqualification and DNF messages. Penalty categories are only displayed if the crawler has penalties (gameplay_crawl_utils.hasPenalties).
notes: An empty message ('') is used to clear a category; clearMessage uses it.

In split screen, a message with crawlerId is only sent to the player who controls that vehicle; if it is no longer associated with a player, it is ignored. Without crawlerId, it is broadcast to all stored or connected players.
showPointsMessage displays nothing if the multiplayer session is host (multiplayer_sessionManager.isSessionHost()).
setCrawlUILayout is entirely commented out: the UI layout change does nothing.
The displayed penalty points come from gameplay_crawl_utils.infractionPoints.
onCrawlResultsShown and onExtensionLoaded are empty bodies.

showPointsMessage.desc: Displays the total penalty points (duration 600 s, category 'points'), unless hosting a multiplayer session.

showCrawlCompletedMessage.desc: Displays "crawl finished", then (10 s) the time and points if the crawler has penalties.

showSkippedCheckpointsMessage.desc: Displays the number of skipped waypoints and the penalty (skippedCount × infractionPoints.skippedCheckpoint).

eventData.desc: Either a table with crawlerId, or directly the vehicle id.

showDisqualifiedWaitingMessage.desc: Displays the waiting message after disqualification (600 s).

showDrivingBackwardsMessage.desc: Displays the backwards driving warning with the drivingBackwards penalty.

showVehicleFlippedUprightMessage.desc: Displays the vehicle-put-back-on-its-wheels message with the vehicleFlippedUpright penalty.

showVehicleResetMessage.desc: Displays the vehicle reset message with the vehicleReset penalty.

showVehicleRecoveredMessage.desc: Displays the vehicle recovery message; the displayed penalty is infractionPoints.vehicleReset (no vehicleRecovered key).

showBoundaryViolationMessage.desc: Displays the zone exit message with the boundaryViolation penalty.

showGateClearedMessage.desc: Displays the message for a gate cleared cleanly.

onCrawlStarted.desc: Hook called when a crawl starts: logs and calls setCrawlUILayout (no effect).

onCrawlComplete.desc: Hook called at the end of a crawl: calls setCrawlUILayout(false) (no effect).

onCrawlResultsShown.desc: Hook called when the results are displayed: empty body.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: empty body.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: forgets the players stored for the messages.
